about: cursorful.com: scrolled onto the embedded YouTube demo, which plays its whole story (its own cursor browsing, clicking a thumbnail, saving to a playlist), back to the top, then Pricing and Editor in the fixed nav bar. Exported 2026-09-23 as 'Cursorful-demo (1)'.
notes: The creator's pointer rests at the left margin (68,500) while they scroll, outside the demo.

The demo's own hand clicks the earth thumbnail at ~3.9s (823,460): flash, a big consequence, a hand. The first version of the 2026-09-24 fix zoomed on it; the 'in-picture' refusal in events.js exists because of it.

stranger_budget_s is a RATCHET, not a target: 4.27s measured on 2026-09-24, all of it while the creator's pointer was hidden by keyboard scrolling and the page stood still — the demo's hand followed, never zoomed on. Lower it when it improves; never raise it.

2026-09-24 (later): with the model, the demo hand stretches (2.37-5.73s, 11.90-12.60s) are judged somebody else's and not drawn: 0.00s. The pixel-only fallback still measures 4.27s, held to stranger_budget_pixel_s.
